    Visual craft · 12 Jul 2026 · 12 min read

    Reading type at a distance

    Why long documents need different spacing than screens, and how to bridge them.

    Why long documents need different spacing than screens, and how to bridge them.

    The problem with a gallery

    A portfolio shows that you can finish something. It rarely shows how you decide. Students are not buying the finished illustration; they are buying the sentences you say while making it.

    So the first lesson is always the same: narrate one decision, out loud, over a recording of your own hand.

    What we changed

    Three things. The course page leads with a finished piece. The first lesson is free and ends mid-problem. The price is visible before the syllabus.

    A course is an argument that ends with the student holding something.

    None of that is clever. It is just the difference between a gallery and a classroom.

    Ana Torres
